text:
maria: quick ask — can someone run onboarding perf for orca2-7b q4_k_m (tokenizer v2) across H100 and A10? need p50/p99 latency and tokens/sec for seq=512 and seq=2048. goal is to validate no regressions vs baseline 7b-rt v2. baseline numbers attached in thread below.

alex: I can pick this up. which runtime build should I use? main or the perf-experiments branch?

maria: perf-experiments (hash bb3f8) — it includes the recent kernel selector change. also please test with kv-cache enabled and disabled.

sam: heads-up: for seq=2048 we'll need to bump max-tokens in the worker config to avoid early truncation. use --max-ctx 2048 in the bench harness.

alex: noted. quick sanity check on command i'm planning to run:
```
./bench_runner --model orca2-7b-q4_k_m --device h100 --branch perf-experiments --batch 1 --seq 512 --kv-cache on --runs 20 --profile --max-ctx 2048
```
will do the same for seq 2048 and then repeat with device a10.

liz: also include a small multi-concurrency run: batch=1 with conc=8 to simulate our peak QPS. that'll show scheduling/backpressure.

alex: doing single-conc runs then conc=8. posting raw logs and summary to s3 when done.

perf-bot: started job 1768456130 for alex on h100 (perf-experiments). estimated 30m.

alex: first pass H100 seq512 results (kv on): p50=22ms, p99=88ms, tokens/s=5100. seq2048 (kv on): p50=95ms, p99=420ms, tokens/s=4800. kv off makes p99 for seq2048 jump to ~780ms — consistent with expectations.

maria: thanks. can you run the A10 set next? we need to compare to baseline: baseline H100 seq512 p99=80ms tokens/s=5000; baseline A10 seq512 p99=160ms tokens/s=2600.

alex: A10 results (q4_k_m): seq512 p50=48ms p99=170ms tokens/s=2700. seq2048 p50=220ms p99=980ms tokens/s=2500. concurrency 8 on A10 shows tail spikes — p99 ~1.6s. full logs: s3://rw-inference/bench/1768456123/alex/orca2-7b/

sam: looks like H100 meets our perf SLO for seq512; A10 is in line with baseline. the perf-experiments branch didn't regress H100 but we do have worse tail at high conc on A10 — could be scheduler parameters.

liz: Alex, can you attach the exact kernel selector config used? also include model compile flags (e.g., use-fused-attn: true/false).

alex: kernel_selector config attached in s3 path above (file kernel-config.json). compile flags: --fused-attn=true --use-32bit-prefetch=false --quant-backend=qint4.

perf-bot: uploaded summary CSV and perf graphs to s3://rw-inference/bench/1768456123/alex/orca2-7b/summary.csv and graphs.zip

maria: perfect. can someone add a short note in the onboarding doc: "Orca2-7b q4_k_m: H100 nominal, A10 acceptable but watch concurrency tail. Recommend enabling kv-cache by default for >512 seq." will file a PR if no objections.

sam: +1 on PR. liz, want me to open a follow-up to tweak A10 scheduler params and rerun concurrency test?

liz: please do. tag me on the issue.

alex: i'll add the raw bench commands and the s3 links into the model onboarding PR.

maria: thanks all. marking this as published. ping me if you see any regressions in the next 48h. :thumbsup:
